# S402 — Merged-run spec cleanup keeps a later spec check

*Proposed.* The merge-found cleanup removes a spec-check directory only when nothing in it is newer than the run's commit, so a restart or a git error never removes a later spec check of the same item.

**Findings:** 2026-11-17 re-check of the S229 later note (S307, 2026-11-07) at f48a6154. `checkMerged` finds a merge by `previous == nil || !*previous` (`internal/daemon/landed.go:205`); `d.runs.merged` starts empty after a restart and holds nil after a git error (`landed.go:180-187,207`), so the removal in `removeMergedSpecDirs` (`landed.go:220-235`) fires again and removes whatever spec check of that item exists then. · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**2026-11-17** — A merged stopped run removes its item's spec-check directory only when the run has a commit time and no file in the check is newer than that commit. A restart or a git error leaves a later spec check of the same item. A run cleaned while git ran, and a committed run with no commit time, remove nothing.

## Why

Owner decisions (2026-11-17): none of adj 436-443 applies. adj 405 (`speccheck.merged-cleanup`, decided 2026-11-17) chose removal when the merge is found, with the reasoning "guarded against restart and git errors"; this slice adds that guard.

From the S307 later note on S229 (2026-11-07), re-checked at HEAD f48a6154:

- Re-fire after a restart, still present. `d.runs.merged` is in memory only; a new daemon starts it empty, so the first HEAD check finds every merged committed run with `previous == nil` and removes its item's spec-check directory (`internal/daemon/landed.go:146-150,205-207,220-235`). `TestMergedCommitStoppedRunDropsItsSpecCheckDir` covers only the same daemon finding the merge again (`internal/daemon/landed_test.go:165-182`).
- Re-fire after a git error, still present. A failed `merge-base` stores `results[id] = nil` (`landed.go:180-187`) and the write-back sets `d.runs.merged[id] = nil` (`:207`); the next pass that reads `true` sees `previous == nil` and removes again. `TestUnmergedOrUnknownCommitStoppedRunKeepsItsSpecCheckDir` (`:184-197`) checks only one pass.
- False-to-true transition, test missing. No test runs `merge-base` exit 1 and then 0 and checks the removal (`rg -n 'Seq' internal/daemon/landed_test.go` shows `Seq` only for `rev-parse`, `landed_test.go:45`).
- Run cleaned while git ran, test missing for the spec directory. The write-back skips a run cleaned meanwhile before it is added to `found` (`landed.go:200-204`), and `TestAPassDoesNotWriteMergedForARunCleanedMeanwhile` (`:1109-1127`) checks the merged value only, not the spec directory.

## Failing tests

All in `internal/daemon/landed_test.go`. `committedRun` gains a `Commit{SHA: "c1", At: T}`; the spec-check helper sets the mtime of every file it writes with `os.Chtimes`.

- `TestMergedSpecCleanupKeepsALaterSpecCheckAfterARestart`: `landingDaemon` (merged), a committed run with `Commit.At` T, a spec-check directory whose files are dated T+1h. A first daemon finds the merge: the directory stays (it is newer). Then build a second daemon on the same store and state dir (`New(cfg)`) and refresh HEAD: the directory and the entry stay. Red first: the restart's first pass removes it.
- `TestMergedSpecCleanupKeepsALaterSpecCheckAfterAGitError`: `merge-base` route with `Seq` exits 0, 2, 0 across three HEAD changes; the spec directory is dated T-1h before the first pass and rewritten dated T+1h after it. Want: removed on the first pass, kept after the third. Red first: the third pass (nil to true) removes the newer directory.
- `TestMergedSpecCleanupOnAFalseToTrueTransition`: `Seq` exits 1 then 0; a directory dated T-1h. Want kept after the first pass, removed after the second. Passes on arrival; pins the transition the note says no test covers.
- `TestMergedSpecCleanupSkipsARunCleanedWhileGitRan`: as `TestAPassDoesNotWriteMergedForARunCleanedMeanwhile`, with a directory dated T-1h: after the pass the directory is kept. Passes on arrival; pins the guard at `landed.go:228-231`.
- `TestMergedCommitStoppedRunDropsItsSpecCheckDir` (existing): its directories are dated before `Commit.At`; it keeps passing.
- `TestMergedSpecCleanupNeedsACommitTime`: a committed run with no `Commit` and an old directory: kept. Red first: removed.

## Implement

1. Write the failing tests above and see them red for the stated reason.
2. `removeMergedSpecDirs`: for each found run, skip it when `rec.Commit == nil` or `rec.Commit.At` is zero, or when any file in `d.specDir(project, item)` has a modification time after `rec.Commit.At`. Read the times without holding `specStateMu` or `runs.mu`, then take the locks (`specStateMu` before `mu`) and remove. Keep the transition rule at `landed.go:205`.
3. Docs: `docs/state.md:176-181,430-434`: the removal applies only to a spec check older than the run's commit, so a restart or a git error never removes a later one (*proposed*, adj 405). CHANGELOG.md: one bullet at the end of `## Unreleased`.

Owner decisions (2026-11-17): Who runs the Commit.At source check? -> orchestrator: assign `rg -n 'Commit.At' internal/daemon/landed.go` to the orchestrator; done when it prints a matching line.

## Check

Acceptance criteria:

- After a daemon restart, a spec check of an item made after its merged run's commit stays.
- After a git error and a later successful merge check, a newer spec check stays.
- A run first seen not merged, then merged, removes its older spec check once.
- A run cleaned while git ran removes nothing.
- A committed run with no commit time removes nothing.

Commands:

- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./internal/daemon -run 'MergedSpecCleanup|MergedCommitStopped' -v` lists the new tests as passing.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.

Orchestrator (owner decision 2026-11-17): the orchestrator runs the Commit.At source check, searching internal/daemon/landed.go for Commit.At. Done when that search prints a matching line. That search is not an ork Check command.
